Meet Sara the broad view

The work is broad. The point of view is focused.

Multi-faceted leader and one-person marketing department for a $11.9M Iowa nonprofit serving 200 members across western Iowa. Eight-plus years directing every facet of marketing, brand strategy, digital, SEO/AEO/GEO, paid search, social, email, content, video production, graphic design, web development, and analytics, while also assisting with IT support for 90+ devices, supporting HR recruiting and retention, and driving fundraising communications and grant initiatives. Known for pioneering AI search visibility programs and turning small teams into outsized results.

I am a nonprofit marketing leader in western Iowa. As Head of Marketing at WESCO Industries in Denison, I am a one person marketing department carrying director level scope: brand, digital strategy, AI search visibility, fundraising communications, and grant support for a $11.9M organization. I mentor nonprofit leaders through the ANCOR Leadership Academy, chair the Uptown Improvement Committee in Denison, and take on freelance design work for campaigns and print clients.

02 · Selected work the receipts

Selected work

Four projects that show the range: search, web, AI visibility, and the measurement underneath all of it.

Tour results pending

Residential census Search launch

ProblemResidential census growth needed a focused search path for families considering care in Western Iowa.

ActionBuilt and published a dedicated Google Search campaign with 22 targeted keywords, matched residential landing page, and private tour call to action.

ResultEnabled and eligible campaign built to turn high intent searches into qualified tour requests. Conversion results are pending while the campaign learns.

4 complete site migrations

Bake Shop website rebuild

ProblemA business critical site needed a more flexible home than its existing Wix build.

ActionRebuilt the Bake Shop and Back 30 experience, then migrated the site from Wix to Cloudflare Pages.

ResultA live, code based website with full control over structure, performance, and future updates.

Cited in Google AI Overviews

GEO and AI visibility program

ProblemTraditional search alone was no longer enough as people began asking AI tools for answers and recommendations.

ActionBuilt a generative engine visibility strategy around YouTube transcripts, Reddit participation, answer focused content, and search authority.

ResultEarned citations in Google AI Overviews and created a repeatable visibility program for AI driven discovery.

3 platforms, one pipeline

Conversion tracking rebuild

ProblemBroken tracking made campaign performance and completed contact paths impossible to measure reliably.

ActionRebuilt conversion logic across Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.

ResultRestored measurable contact and referral pipelines so campaign decisions could be tied to real actions.

Capabilities the full range

More than marketing

Sara Woerdehoff has led the entire marketing function at WESCO Industries, an $11.9 million health and human services nonprofit in western Iowa, since 2018. Her capabilities reach well past a standard marketing role, grouped the way hiring teams and boards read them.

no. 01

Strategy and leadership

Strategic planning and organizational growth, leadership of large teams of diverse populations, recruiting and retention support, mentoring through the ANCOR Leadership Academy, and representing the organization at galas, networking activities, and community events. As chair of the Uptown Improvement Committee since 2020, she won tens of thousands of dollars in grants for the City of Denison, led the Uptown rebrand, and delivered new wayfinding signage for the district. In 2023 she ran for the Carroll Community School District board.

no. 02

Marketing and communications

Brand and digital strategy, content, design, and video production owned end to end, logos and brand identities created for WESCO, the Bake Shop, NOVA, the WAVE, 5th Avenue Fun Center, the Back 30 Event Center, and STAN the chatbot, four complete website migrations, Google Ads including the $120,000 Google Ad Grant she secured, along with additional grant funding she secured for WESCO, four Google certifications, an AI search visibility program she built from scratch, and fundraising communications and donor campaigns, with a Candid Platinum Seal of Transparency earned during her tenure. She is quoted in five western Iowa newspapers: the Denison Bulletin and Review, the Daily Times Herald, the Manila Times, the Manning Monitor, and the Westside Observer, and she has been on air on radio stations KDSN, KNOD, and KKRL. Freelance work includes multiple websites, logos for clients, and graphic design for print companies.

no. 03

Sales and operations

Sales operations at Artf/x, serving as liaison between the Omaha and Lincoln branches of a multimillion dollar company, retail management at Goodwill, where her stores broke multiple sales records, vendor and product evaluation at retail market conferences in Dallas, and foodservice and hospitality marketing for a bakery and café operation.

no. 04

Creative production

Graphic design, screenprinting, embroidery, heat press, painting, drywall, floral design as co manager of a floral business, dress alterations and precise measurements, and the ability to produce the merchandise, signage, and printed pieces a campaign needs, not only plan them.

no. 05

Events and live production

Event management, from planning and materials to logistics, theatre and sound equipment, job fair support behind the scenes, and a practiced, comfortable presence at galas and public events.

no. 06

Organizational backbone

Organizational charts, policies, handbooks, training videos, safety documentation, including fire escape plans, and IT assistance across more than 90 devices.
